page_title: What exists, how to ask for it and where it is written
page_lede: Forty-eight practical entries. Each one addresses a real-life situation, explains what can be requested and links to the official source where it is set out. At the end of each entry, you can see the concepts in the collection that overlap with it.
description: 48 practical everyday-life entries on support, rights, health, education, work, home, relationships and safety, with linked sources.
aviso: This information is for guidance and has no legal validity. For benefits, deadlines and administrative procedures, always check the linked official source before applying.
criterio: When a Spanish benefit, deadline, right or service is cited, its source is provided. Practical recommendations are presented as support, not as clinical treatment. A specific adjustment depends on the person and the context; a diagnosis on its own does not automatically entitle someone to every measure described.
